trap.label: phrasal verb bring up
trap.wrong: He was bringed up in Recife and brought up it.
trap.right: He was brought up in Recife, and he brought it up.
trap.why: Em português verbos regulares são mais comuns; o brasileiro regulariza irregulares (bringed). Phrasal verbs separáveis: pronome entra no meio.

mcq.q: Which is correct? (phrasal verb bring up)

fix.wrong: I was brought up on Recife.
fix.right: I was brought up in Recife.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com it: “He brought up the idea.”
Reescreva no passado: “She brings up the topic.”
Reescreva na passiva: “His parents raised him in Recife.” (brought up)
rewrite.answer: He was brought up in Recife.
